name: Kamal Khujandi
contribution: A Persian sufi and Persian ghazal poet of the 14th century.
legacy: He is counted among the great romantic poets of the 14th century, like Amir Khosrow Dehlavi, Khwaju Kermani and Hafez

checks.lead: Kamal Khujandi (Persian: کمال خجندی; 1320–1400), also Kamal Khojandi, Kamaleddin Khojandi, or Kamal-e Khojandi, was a Persian sufi and Persian ghazal poet of the 14th century (8th century hijri).
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
